subject: angol
title: City life and country life
instructionsHu: Nézd meg a két kép leírását. Írd le őket, hasonlítsd össze a városi és a vidéki életet, majd válaszolj a vizsgáztató kérdéseire.

scenes.description: A teenage boy is riding an electric scooter along a busy street in a big city. There are tall blocks of flats, shops and a crowded tram stop behind him. Cars are waiting at the traffic lights, and people are walking fast with coffee cups in their hands. It is a grey morning and everyone seems to be in a hurry.

A girl of about fifteen is feeding chickens in the garden of an old house in a small village. Her grandfather is working in the vegetable garden next to her, and a cat is sleeping in the sun on the fence. In the background there are green fields, a church tower and a few houses. It is quiet and peaceful.

prompts: Describe the places and what the people are doing.
What are the good and bad sides of living in each place?
Where would you like to live in the future? Why?
followUpQuestions: Do you live in a town or a village? Do you like it?
How do you get to school every day?
Have you ever stayed in the countryside for a longer time? What was it like?
What animals live in or near your home?
What could your town do to make life better for young people?

usefulPhrases.en: In the background there is / there are ...
In the city there are more opportunities.
Life is slower in the countryside.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: In the first picture a teenage boy is riding an electric scooter along a busy city street. Behind him there are tall blocks of flats and a crowded tram stop, and everyone seems to be in a hurry. In the second picture a girl is feeding chickens in the garden of an old village house, while her grandfather is working in the vegetable garden. It looks really quiet and peaceful. In both pictures young people are outdoors, but the two places are completely different. Both places have good and bad sides. In a city there are more jobs and things to do, but it's noisy and the air is often polluted. In a village, life is calmer and healthier, but you need a car to get anywhere. In the future I'd like to live in a city like Győr, at least while I'm young.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Have you ever stayed in the countryside for a longer time? What was it like?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Yes, I spent two weeks at my grandparents' house near Kecskemét last summer. It was relaxing, but after a week I started to miss my friends.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a vizsgázó mindkét jelenetet leírja, mindkét lakóhely előnyeit és hátrányait is felsorolja, megmondja, hol szeretne élni és miért, a rákérdezésre pedig saját élménnyel felel.
Szókincs: a városi és vidéki élet szavai változatosak (blocks of flats, tram stop, in a hurry, peaceful, polluted, calmer and healthier).
Nyelvhelyesség: a „there are” szerkezet, a középfokú melléknevek (calmer, healthier) és a folyamatos jelen a képleírásban helyesek, a „Have you ever …?” kérdésre egyszerű múlttal ad konkrét választ.
Érdemes megtanulni: „everyone seems to be in a hurry”, „Both places have good and bad sides.”, „you need a car to get anywhere”, „at least while I'm young”.
